title: Domain History Contact OSINT Output
description: A contacts table with per-contact provenance, plus the full per-domain report as the run's OUTPUT record.

contacts.title: Contacts with provenance
contacts.description: One row per contact per source: emails, phones, people and organisations with sourceUrl, snapshotTimestamp, extractionMethod, confidence and the full sightings array. People carry role, worksFor, relation (site or mention) and the evidence line. One summary row per domain closes each block with the coverage verdict.

report.title: Domain report
report.description: Status, registration, DNS and hosting history with IP geolocation, certificates, archived pages, server software, tracking IDs, mentions, and a per-section coverage report saying which sources answered. A single domain gives the report itself; a batch gives { domains: [...] }.
